body.purpose: Provisional — Geist via next/font, not yet a confirmed brand pairing per SHAPE.md's open decision.

shadows.name: card-resting
shadows.purpose: Minimal lift on Card, the only shadow step currently used.

motion.name: snap-and-settle
motion.purpose: Dialog open/close and status-change transitions — a decisive single step, never a bounce or cross-fade, per SHAPE.md.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button — navy-ink fill, the system's default 'primary' role.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; background: #031130; color: #f3f7f3; border: none; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(3, 17, 48, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #185df1; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base container — paper surface, ledger-rule border, minimal shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #768193; background: #f3f7f3; color: #031130; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(3, 17, 48, 0.05); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-content { padding: 0 1.5rem 1.5rem; }

components.name: Table Row
components.description: Ruled-row table — the atomic unit of every SaHei screen (one call, one booking, one analytics line).
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-th { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; text-align: left; font-weight: 500; color: #545e6f; border-bottom: 1px solid #768193; } .ds-tr { border-bottom: 1px solid #768193; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-tr:hover { background: rgba(231, 235, 243, 0.5); } .ds-tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-td { padding: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal panel — centered, ledger-rule border, black scrim (the system's one hardcoded, non-token color).
components.css: .ds-dialog-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); } .ds-dialog { position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 100%; max-width: 32rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #768193; background: #f3f7f3; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(3, 17, 48, 0.15); } .ds-dialog-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; color: #031130; }

components.name: Section Nav Item
components.description: Vertical ledger-tab-divider nav item — active state carries the system's other reserved Wire Blue appearance.
components.html: Calls / TranscriptsBookings / Calendar
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #545e6f; border-left: 2px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #e7ebf3; color: #031130; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-left-color: #185df1; background: #e7ebf3; color: #031130; }

narrative.overview: SaHei's dashboard reads as the shop's own bound appointment daybook — ruled rows, ink-stamped status — now kept by an AI. The audience is a non-technical small-business owner checking, in short sessions often on a phone, whether calls are being handled and bookings are landing. Operate mode: task completion outranks persuasion or decoration. The system commits to one accent, used rarely: a wire-blue reserved for a single 'live/active' role, not a general-purpose brand color. Everything else is navy ink on off-white paper.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled rows and visible borders over soft shadow-based separation
Status shown as a stamped label, never a colored pill
Crisper, less-rounded corners than default shadcn

rules.name: The One Role Rule
rules.body: Wire Blue appears in exactly one place at a time: the thing that is currently focused or currently active. It is never a fill color.

rules.name: The No Display Serif Rule
rules.body: No display serif anywhere in this system — confirmed exclusion from SHAPE.md, not a default.

rules.name: The Crisper-Not-Sharper Rule
rules.body: Corners are tighter than stock shadcn to read as structured/ledger-like, but never fully square on a content surface — only on small in-line controls.

dos: Do keep Wire Blue to exactly one live/active signal at a time (focus ring, active nav rule).
Do use a visible, measured-contrast rule for dividers and borders.
Do keep buttons and cards flat; reach for the ledger-rule border before reaching for a shadow.
donts: Don't fill a button, badge, or background with Wire Blue.
Don't add a colored status pill; use the ink-stamp overprint treatment instead, once scoped.
Don't add playful, gamified, or marketing-glossy elements.
